note: Provenance for the landing page's product material. Staleness in a capture is invisible in review — the old gallery shipped a v0.0.42beta window with an empty Mission Board and a stray text selection for weeks. Recording what each asset was captured from makes the gap a fact instead of an impression. test/lander-assets.test.ts asserts this file agrees with both src/assets/lander and public/media, whose files are listed here under a media/ prefix.

refresh.gallery: Run the desktop app on the target release, drive it to the state each shot describes, and capture the window. Shots must show real work, not an empty state.
refresh.conceptFlow: qa/record-real-client-demo.ps1 records the desktop window against a live task, then qa/curate-client-demo.mjs edits the frames into the GIF.
refresh.demoVideo: Generate the zh-CN and en-US V5R masters from the same 12-scene renderer, complete the SHA-bound five-frame gate and final inspection for each locale, then encode each accepted master to H.264/AAC with 48 kHz stereo audio and +faststart. Extract the poster from 250 seconds of that locale's physical web file so the idle player shows the final brand, author and project addresses without subtitles. The route locale is the only media selector: / uses en-US and /zh-cn/ uses zh-CN.

knownIssues: empty state: 'No work yet.', Mission Board 0
stray text selection highlight in the composer
